title: docs(releases): fold #25541, #25550 and #25429 into the 18.1.0 notes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiRwWtsarkLPmw9fMYiFZ3LY)_

## Summary

Three more changesets reached `main` after #25553 was compiled at `19d3720af1`. They are still before the 18.1.0 cut. This PR folds them into the 18.1.0 notes. It changes docs only.

- **#25550** is breaking (`minor`, narrowed). The permission save door now refuses a row policy that reads a membership key nothing owns. An object write that breaks a stored policy is refused too. Both are added under "Metadata the build and the save doors now refuse".
- **#25541** is semantic. An `external` holder is now its own posture, with an owner-only org-wide default. It is added under "Semantic changes".
- **#25429** is a fix to the skills docs. It is counted under other fixes.

The counts become 253 entries, split 78 / 9 / 47 / 2 / 117 across the five sections. 87 changesets are declared breaking, 48 `minor` and 39 `patch`. `check-adr-0087-registration --list` confirms 87 out of 87. The counts are updated on the 18.1 page, the v18 index, the releases index and Backward Compatibility.
